name: Limestone (United States)
description: Vertical tricolour of dark green, brown and dark green, the brown centre stripe edged in yellow.
history: Limestone is a town in Aroostook County, Maine. The flag was adopted in 2022 (developed by seventh-grade pupils of Limestone Community School in a contest begun in November 2021 and adopted by the town in June 2022, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: narrow yellow stripes edging the centre
